Long, flowing, platinum white hair with straight bangs and a soft, airy texture. Large, drooping, pale blue eyes with a timid, shy expression. Apparent age is a young adolescent with a youthful, innocent face. Petite, slight build. A white and light blue sailor-style dress with a wide collar and a small blue bow. Signature details include a large, plush white stuffed animal toy held in the arms and a small, white sailor cap.
BODY COLOR: pale porcelain
